lessons.title: Geometry

explanation_sections.title: Geometry
explanation_sections.body:
A right angle is 90°, a straight angle is 180°, and angles around a point total 360°. The interior angles of
a triangle total 180°.

lessons.source_reference: ElimuQuest Mathematics Curriculum Draft v1, PDF p. 7
lessons.author: ElimuQuest

questions.prompt: Two angles on a straight line are x° and 65°. Find x.
A triangle has angles 45° and 75°. Find its third angle.
Find the missing angle around a point if the other angles are 90°, 120° and 80°.
State two properties of a rectangle.
questions.correct_answer: Opposite sides equal and parallel; all angles are 90°.
